description: Different model profiles should preserve static Cargo lib and bin source ownership, logical module paths, and exact test evidence outside the conventional src layout.

lockedFields.reason: Complete package-local source target ownership should retain the native Cargo command.
Existing static repository-contained lib and bin paths should not introduce blockers.
The custom binary root and three still-untested manifest-rooted module files should remain add-test items.
The library root, associated-function calculator, and module-tested validator should remain extend-test items.
The custom library path should remain a stable source target with inline evidence.
The library root's inline built-in test should retain asserted direct evidence.
The custom binary root should retain its manifest-owned path in the plan.
The logical calculator module should retain exact associated-function evidence.
The named Calculator import should preserve its asserted associated call.
The logical validator module should retain direct unit and integration evidence.
The crate-relative unit-test import should remain attached to the validator module.
The package-name integration import should resolve through the custom logical module graph.
